column1: # Alex waits in the Altin Peak west exit after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: You lit that lighthouse.\nI know the look.{page_break}Everyone down there\nwears it now.{end_wait}
Who are you? What happened\nin the mine?{end_wait}
Ask what didn't. The rock\nmoved on its own, and then\nthe screaming started.{end_wait}
Go on. Dig if you have the\nstomach for it. Don't\nexpect thanks.{end_wait}
